highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: ECE Paris is a prestigious private engineering school offering multiple courses in the fields of engineering and technology. The name ECE Paris stands for École d'Ingénieurs Paris. The school offers a variety of specialised programs, including Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Electronics, Telecommunications, and more. Its central location in Paris offers you many professional and networking opportunities as well.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value: At ECE Paris, you’ll be part of a vibrant, multicultural community. The university welcomes students from across the globe with 33 student clubs, organisations, and events, including music, arts, video games, fashion, cinema, and many more. You’ll also get personalised counselling services, such as academic advice, career guidance, or emotional support from ECE’s dedicated team.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value: ECE Paris does not provide on-campus housing. However, it offers you various support to help you find comfortable and convenient housing options nearby. ECE partners with a range of student residence halls, apartments, and private rental options, ensuring that you can find a place that suits your preferences and budget.
